record.body:
## Evidence

25 loaded runs of test_detail_screen_redraws_when_the_store_changes failed 5 times, all at dashboard_app.py paint query_one("#related"). After the fix: 30/30 loaded, 30/30 alone, two full suites 250 passed.

## Consequence

The failure was a real race in the screen, not a slow test. It could also fire when you press Esc during a redraw.

## Follow-up

The earlier 20 s timeout variant did not reproduce; watch for it in later full runs.
